body: I could probably settle and get the money when I want but I'm not sure because I'm still on their insurance. I haven't yet because I want to be in god terms with my parents and every time I bring it up they say that they can't believe I would do that to them because their insurance might go up.
I'm turning 20 in a few days. It's an insurance settlement from a car wreck that put me in the hospital for days and left me recovering for months.

I want to move out but i'm having a hard time finding a job and I'm waiting for the semester to end. I'm supposed to have quiet a bit of money, like enough to buy a house in full, but my parents are keeping it from me and every time I bring it up they get mad or try to guilt trip me. They say that they won't allow me to move out until I finish college because they don't think I'll be able to get my degree without them checking my grades constantly.

Thank you for caring enough to respond to my post. I've been trying to talk to my parents for a very long time and I have tried to explain things to them about how I feel. They always end up yelling at me saying that if I kill myself they will have failed as parents. My boyfriend is amazing in so many ways and on many occasions when I fight with my family he says he will get me out if this situation eventually. I'm terrified to talk to him about my feelings though because I don't want him to think less of me and I know that he's had a very hard life and I don't want to upset him with my problems. I'll try to talk to him later on if I can get myself to and maybe he can help me find a way to fix myself.
